add_address.title: What do you want to add?
add_address.description: Sfeer rooms are added separately (menu: Add Sfeer room).

detect_address.title: Detect an address
detect_address.description:
Be ready to switch a module. Detection starts when you click below.

During detection it is enough to turn an RLM or a SoftM on or off. Send a cover up.

detect_kind.title: What is this address?
detect_kind.description: {group}.{address} turned {state}. Choose whether this is an RLM, a SoftM, or a cover. For a cover, only Set counts as up. The next step listens for down.

detect_timeout.title: Nothing heard
detect_timeout.description: No new Set or Reset arrived. Be ready to change the module, then try again.

detect_up_again.title: Send the cover up
detect_up_again.description: A Reset arrived. That is the other relay, not the direction you sent. Send the cover up again. When you click below, Home Assistant listens for Set.

detect_close.title: Send the cover down
detect_close.description: Be ready to send the cover down. Detection starts again when you click below.

detect_close_timeout.title: No down address
detect_close_timeout.description: The down address did not arrive.

add_rlm.title: Add switch (RLM)
add_rlm.description: One bus address as a Home Assistant switch. On and off commands are sent to this address. Add a SoftM with the SoftM type, not here.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Ask the bus for current on/off when Home Assistant starts

add_dimmer.title: Add dimmer
add_dimmer.description:
One dimmer, by its physical group and address. The group is the room. The slider sends a percent. On and off send Set and Reset.

Memo means the module remembers the dim level when off. When Memo is on, the module returns to its last level on Set and the slider follows. When it is off, a plain Set shows 100%.

When “Participates in Sfeer” is on, a Sfeer in this group clears the known percent. On or off follows the Set or Reset the dimmer itself sends back.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Ask the bus for current on/off when Home Assistant starts

add_softm.title: Add SoftM
add_softm.description:
A SoftM software member. Home Assistant controls it with Set and Reset.

Enable the Virtual Status Module when Home Assistant should answer Toggle, Status and Timer for this address. Leave it off when a hardware status module already tracks this SoftM. The master switch in Integration settings must also be on. The timer and the remembered on/off apply only while the Virtual Status Module is enabled.

data.name: Name
data.enable_softm_status_tracking: Enable Virtual Status Module for this address
data.softm_timer: SoftM timer (seconds; 0 = off). After a Timer command, turn on then auto off.
data.persist_state: Remember SoftM on/off across Home Assistant restarts
data.default_state: If nothing was remembered, start SoftM as on

add_aud.title: Add AUD (audio)
add_aud.description:
Audio module, usually group 4. Choose who acts on commands sent to this address.

BHS keeps the eight source names as labels on this card and controls the real player itself.

Home Assistant links this address to another media player. The next screens pick that player and then one of its sources for each of the eight DSM buttons.

add_aud_player.title: Link a media player
add_aud_player.description: Pick the player Home Assistant should control when a command arrives for this AUD. The next screen lists the sources that player is reporting. If it reports none, turn it on and open this screen again. Editing that same player while it is quiet keeps the sources already saved.

add_aud_sources.title: AUD source names
add_aud_sources.description: Names shown for the eight sources. An empty name is stored as Source 1 … Source 8. BHS keeps control of the real player.

add_aud_links.title: Link the eight sources
add_aud_links.description:
Each DSM source number uses one source from the linked player. The same source can be chosen more than once. Stop and mute use a command this player supports.

{mute_note}

add_rtc.title: Add RTC (bus clock)
add_rtc.description:
Keeps the bus clock in sync (default address 1.1) by writing the time with Program sequences.

Default: every 12 hours at minute :17 (not on the hour). Startup sync runs after other status queries. DST sync waits a short delay after the clock change.

data.name: Name
data.sync_minute: Sync at this minute past the hour (avoid 0)
data.sync_on_startup: Sync when the integration starts (after status queries)
data.dst_delay_minutes: Minutes to wait after a DST change before syncing

add_ldm.title: Add LDM (light sensor)
add_ldm.description: Outdoor/indoor light sensor on the bus. Levels also arrive on their own when the sensor updates. A Refresh button asks for a reading now.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Read light level when Home Assistant starts

add_tsm.title: Add TSM (temperature)
add_tsm.description: Thermostat / temperature module. Readings include measured temperature, active preset and setpoint. A Refresh button asks for a reading now.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Read temperature when Home Assistant starts

add_wsm.title: Add WSM (wind speed)
add_wsm.description: Wind speed on the bus, in km/h. Readings also arrive on their own when the sensor updates. A Refresh button asks for a reading now.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Read wind speed when Home Assistant starts

add_bm8.title: Add BM8 (doorbell)
add_bm8.description: Doorbell with eight built-in chimes. Home Assistant adds a button for each chime, and a Stop button. A press sounds that chime. The group is usually 1.

add_shutter.title: Add cover (roller / shutter)
add_shutter.description: A cover uses two bus addresses: one for open, one for close. Travel times only estimate when Home Assistant shows open or closed — they do not drive the motors.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Ask the bus which relay is on when Home Assistant starts

add_shutter_detect.title: Add cover (roller / shutter)
add_shutter_detect.description: A cover uses two bus addresses: one for open, one for close. Travel times only estimate when Home Assistant shows open or closed — they do not drive the motors. Only the up relay was seen. Enter the down relay by hand. Adding a cover this way still has rough edges.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Ask the bus which relay is on when Home Assistant starts

import_bhs_pending.title: Waiting for approval
import_bhs_pending.description: BLConfig has to approve the device named "Home Assistant". Then continue.

import_bhs_pick.title: Choose members

import_bhs_secured.title: Secured BHS
import_bhs_secured.description:
This BHS encrypts the API (ISSECURE). The import stopped before adding any modules.

Please send this file to raf.verbiest@gmail.com. It would help development.

{path}

Careful — this file contains your private key. Create a new key and delete the old one from the BHS before you send the email.

integration_settings.title: Integration settings
integration_settings.description:
SoftM tracking (master switch): when enabled, Home Assistant can answer Toggle/Status for addresses that also have SoftM tracking turned on. Do not use a hardware STM on those same addresses.

Bus repeater: Home Assistant keeps the single gateway link and listens on this host (default port 10001) so BLConfig or blxmonitor can share the bus. Point those tools at the Home Assistant IP, not the gateway IP. Allowed subnet is a CIDR (for example 192.168.50.0/24). Localhost is always allowed. Leave the subnet empty to keep the previous behaviour (the gateway’s /24).

add_readonly.title: Add read-only address
add_readonly.description: Like a normal bus address, but Home Assistant never sends control commands. It only watches Set/Reset (and may ask for on/off at startup). Useful for inputs or any address you want to observe without controlling.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the BHS. Check the address, the port, and that Home Assistant can reach that PC.
error.pending_approval: This device is waiting for approval in BLConfig.
error.bhs_secured: This BHS encrypts the API (ISSECURE). This import does not speak that mode yet.
error.bhs_blocked: BLConfig blocked this device. Submit again to register a new one.
error.invalid_yaml: Could not read or parse the YAML file.
error.detect_not_running: The gateway is not connected. Start the integration and try again.
error.template_missing: The template file could not be found.
error.invalid_format: The YAML structure or one or more entries is invalid.
error.softm_check_conflict: SoftM tracking already answers Status for this address. Turn off “Ask the bus … when Home Assistant starts”. Also skip SoftM tracking here if a hardware STM already tracks this SoftM.
error.softm_command_conflict: SoftM tracking answers Toggle on the bus. Set “Command to turn on” to Set and “Command to turn off” to Reset — other commands (such as Toggle) would flip the SoftM twice.
error.softm_timer_needs_vsm: The SoftM timer is answered by the Virtual Status Module. Enable it for this address, or set the timer to 0.
error.invalid_subnet: Allowed subnet must be a CIDR such as 192.168.50.0/24.
error.aud_no_sources: This player is not reporting any sources. Turn it on and open this screen again.
error.aud_no_stop: This player has no stop, pause, or turn off, so it cannot be linked.
error.aud_no_features: This player is not reporting what it can do. Turn it on and open this screen again.
